spotlight.title: This Month's Spotlight
spotlight.intro: Beginning on the first day of each month, one active Mōchirīī website member is selected at random for our guild Spotlight.
body: This month we lift a lantern for {{winnerName}} & celebrate their place in Mōchirīī.
Our guild is shaped by every member who joins us along the cultivation road.
May this Spotlight be a warm reminder that each name gathered beneath our lanterns belongs to the story we share.
spotlight.conclusion: Thank you for being part of Mōchirīī & helping our shared journey continue.
